title: [007] Add a deploy preflight that fails on client AI, stale rules, or failing verification

violation.problem: Nothing stops a deploy with a browser Gemini key, a client AI import, or rules artifacts that drifted from their modules.
violation.expectedSolution: Check the env var, grep `studio/src` for `firebase/ai`, re-resolve both rules and byte-compare, run `rules:verify` and `rules:verify:hosted`; exit 1 on any failure.
